@@ -77,0 +77,14 @@
+ifeq ($(call isTargetOs, linux), true)
+  # Build fails on Linux because WCHAR_MAX is not defined and
+  # WCHAR_MAX is provided by wchar.h
+  BUILD_LIBLCMS_cmstypes.c_CFLAGS := -include wchar.h
+endif
+
+ifeq ($(call isTargetOs, windows), true)
+  # Build doesn't fail on Windows because we don't treat
+  # undefined WCHAR_MAX macro warning as error. But
+  # WCHAR_MAX value is treated as 0. So we explicitly
+  # include wchar.h
+  BUILD_LIBLCMS_cmstypes.c_CFLAGS := -FIwchar.h
+endif
+
